resumen: Ranger of the kill group with **the lowest recorded DPS**: 21.1k, less than half their group’s average (about 45k), 5th in both runs. Also has some of the lowest gear (GS 2865, CP 175k).
fortalezas: In the second run they died less than average (1.67 per attempt versus 2.07) and their first death matched the group (180 s).
mejorar: Damage is the big gap, and it doesn’t look like gear alone: Garretin, with the same CP (175k), does 45k DPS.
In the first run they died earlier and more than average (first death at 137 s versus 173 s; 2.0 deaths per attempt versus 1.48).
Their deaths are spread between 1802840 (3) and several zones: 2920719, 2920717 and 2920718 (2 each).
recomendaciones: Review rotation and build with a Ranger guide: it’s the improvement with the biggest impact on the group.
Upgrade gear afterwards: CP is among the lowest recorded.
